newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fr Telecom says calendar for flotation not fixed.
newsitem.headline: Fr Telecom says calendar for flotation not fixed.

text.p: France Telecom said on Wednesday that a share flotation for at least 25 billion francs was scheduled for May, but the exact dates had not been fixed.

"I can confirm that the flotation will be in May ... for at least 25 billion francs," a France Telecom spokesman told Reuters, citing recent remarks by chairman Michel Bon. "But there's no decision on the calendar," he said.

The French newspaper La Tribune, citing unnamed sources, said a six-day public offer of shares representing 20 percent of France Telecom was scheduled to begin on May 20, with stock trading expected to start at the beginning of June.
Officials at the finance and industry ministries were not immediately available for comment on the report.
